CustomField.description: This field will be an indicator for the initial role out of the lead management process. The reps will indicate specific leads that they want to ensure stay in their database. This field will only be visible through May 10th, 2013.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this box if you would like to keep this lead in your database. You only have until May 10th, 2013 to do so.
